jobs.description_snippet: **Finance Business Analyst — M-KOPA South Africa** =================================================== ### **You've proven you can turn numbers into decisions. Now turn them into financial access for millions.** You're good at what you do. Budgets close on time, forecasts hold up, and when a business leader needs a straight answer on the numbers, they come to you. That's not nothing — most finance careers stall long before that level of trust is earned. But here's the question worth sitting with: how much of that trust is spent explaining what already happened, versus shaping what happens next? At M-KOPA, we're looking for a Finance Business Partner who's ready to spend less time reporting the past and more time building the future — for a business that's scaling access to essential assets across some of the fastest-growing consumer markets in Africa. **Where M-KOPA is right now** M-KOPA has grown to **10 million customers** — up from 5 million just a year ago — unlocking over **$2 billion** in credit for people who'd otherwise been shut out of formal financial services. **86% of our customers** report a real improvement in their quality of life, **70%** use what they've financed to generate income, and **55%** are accessing financial services for the very first time through us. Behind that: 2,300+ employees, 35,000+ agents, $45 million contributed in taxes, 2 million smartphones assembled in Kenya, and 4,000+ e-motorbikes financed — saving riders $5.62 a day. **Why now** If you've noticed M-KOPA advertising for several finance and business roles at once, that's not a coincidence. We're deliberately building out the finance function that will take us from 7 million customers to 10 million — and a Finance Business Partner sits right at the centre of that. This isn't about backfilling a gap. It's about putting the right commercial finance capability in place before we need it, not after. **What makes this different** In a lot of organisations, "business partnering" quietly becomes bookkeeping with better branding — reconciling accounts, chasing accruals, producing packs nobody reads closely. That's not this role. You'll be the person business leaders actually turn to before a decision gets made, not after. You'll build the business cases behind new market and product bets, challenge assumptions in budgets before they become commitments, and have a direct line into how M-KOPA allocates capital across a fast-moving, multi-market business. Share brings the supply and demand together by building distributed routing nodes and connecting carriers, ISPs, data centers, and enterprise buyers through a neutral exchange, turning bandwidth into a liquid, tradeable resource. You'll work alongside our systems engineer and very closely with the network and software teams. **Our Ideal Candidate** * 7+ years of professional systems/infrastructure engineering experience, with real ownership of infrastructure at scale. * A leadership mindset, not just an operational one; you take responsibility for outcomes, catch issues before they become incidents, and push for the right call for your team and the company. * Deep Kubernetes expertise: you've deployed, scaled, and debugged production clusters. * Strong cloud infrastructure experience (GCP preferred): networking, IAM, cost and capacity planning, multi-region architecture. * Real depth across the full stack, old and new: production Docker and container orchestration, and virtualization technologies (VMware, KVM, Hyper-V or similar). jobs.description_snippet: Technical Support Engineer | B2B SaaS **Remote, South Africa · Independent Contractor · Initial 6-month services agreement · £1,200 - £1,600 per month · Client contact: Product Lead** Keepnet isn't just scaling, we're redefining human risk and secure behaviour management in cybersecurity. Trusted by global enterprises including Vodafone, Merck, Arriva and Hershey, we reduce human cyber risk through AI-driven automation, with Agentic AI now extending that capability further. Support is where the product meets reality. Every ticket is a customer telling us something true about the platform, and every ticket is either a problem we keep answering, or a problem we solve once and remove at the source. The services cover customer issues end to end: investigate the evidence, reproduce the problem, hand a proven case to the Product Lead where a code fix is needed, keep the customer informed throughout, then help remove the underlying cause from the product, the documentation or the onboarding flow. This is a technical engagement, not a script-reading helpdesk. It involves reading logs and error records, reproducing bugs in test tenants, and coordinating with our Product Lead in a fast moving SaaS scaleup. This is a fully remote, independent contractor engagement for a provider based in South Africa. The service availability requirements are set out in the engagement terms below. **Before you apply.** This engagement requires prior customer-facing B2B SaaS support experience: a multi-tenant, cloud-based platform that customers configure and run inside their own organisation. The category matters far less than the model, and security experience is welcome rather than required. Internal IT, device support, retail and consumer call centre experience alone won't provide the platform troubleshooting background this engagement needs. Why This Engagement Matters Today, one person runs global support at Keepnet alongside their product responsibilities. That is possible because of how the operation is built: * **Discipline.** Nothing is answered from memory, and nothing closes without a cause recorded * **Documentation quality.** The help centre is maintained to the point where most questions never become tickets * **AI agents accelerate the analysis.** Evidence-based work that used to take an hour of log reading now takes minutes, so the time goes into judgement rather than retrieval * **Monitoring.** We see errors and failures in our own records, at tenant level, without waiting to be told * **Proactive support.** A significant share of issues reach the customer from us first. The conversation starts with "we noticed this on your tenant and here is what we've done", not "sorry to hear that" * **A working relationship with product.** Causes get fixed properly, so the same problem doesn't return as a different ticket next quarter As our customer base grows we need a dedicated provider for this function, so support scales with the business and senior product time go
